entities.summary: Orville Clarence Redenbacher was an American food scientist and businessman most often associated with the brand of popcorn that bears his name which is now owned by Conagra Brands. The New York Times described him as "the agricultural visionary who all but single-handedly revolutionized the American popcorn industry". Orville Redenbacher was a performers & entertainers from Brazil (1907-07-16, Brazil–1995-09-19). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to economic history and geopolitics.
